text:
carol: Quick design check: I mocked a compact welcome rail for the first-run flow. Goal is to reduce vertical footprint on small widths and surface two actions: main onboarding and try-a-sample. Fig link: https://figma.com/file/abc123 — can people scan for CTA weight, microcopy clarity, and a11y issues?

mike: skimmed. The compact rail looks tidy. Concern: both actions currently use solid fills (equal visual weight). We should establish a visual hierarchy: primary filled > secondary outline/ghost. If both are strong, users won't know which to pick.

ravi: +1. Also the sample cards below use icon-only overflow controls. Those are easy to miss on mobile. Can we show label text for the overflow on narrow breakpoints?

carol: Good call. I tried to keep controls minimal but agree discoverability is important. Proposal: show full labels for the first 2 cards on mobile, collapse rest to icon-only.

mike: That compromise seems reasonable. Copy: current primary says \"Get started\" and secondary \"View samples\". Feels inconsistent. Maybe \"Get started\" and \"Try a sample project\" (with time) for the secondary to set expectations.

tori: UI accessibility notes: the secondary outline has 3.9:1 contrast on 13px text vs white background. We need >=4.5:1 for normal text. Either increase stroke darkness or bump size. Also ensure focus outline is 3px wide and visible against gradient.

a11y-bot: Quick check: primary fill (#0b6eff) on white at 14px = 5.2:1 pass, outline stroke (#1e88ff,1px) on white = 3.92:1 fail for normal text. Recommended: use #155ab8 for stroke or increase font to 16px. Also, missing aria-describedby linking sample cards to their time estimate.

ravi: For the time estimate, I suggest inline microcopy: \"Chat demo — 3 min\" rather than separate badge. It reads better to screen readers. Use aria-label on the card anchor like: aria-label=\"Open sample: Chat demo, takes 3 minutes\".

carol: Sounds good. On keyboard flow: currently tab goes rail items -> banner -> samples. But the banner is decorative and contains an external link which interrupts onboarding flow. We should make banner inert for first-run or move it after primary CTA in the tab order.

mike: Agree. A non-essential promotional banner should not break the primary path. Make it aria-hidden or skip-to after onboarding.

tori: Also test SR announcements for toast confirmations. When a user starts a sample, we need an assertive live region saying \"Sample started: Chat demo — progress bar visible\". Right now nothing is announced.

a11y-bot: Note: live region check: no element with role=\"status\" or aria-live present for sample initiation. Recommend aria-live=\"polite\" for non-blocking updates and role=\"status\" for immediate feedback.

ravi: Microcopy tweak: if primary creates a workspace, say \"Create workspace\" vs \"Get started\". The latter is ambiguous. Which action does the primary do in this prototype?

carol: Prototype triggers a workspace create + starter content. So we should use \"Create workspace\" to be explicit, but add a short subcopy: \"Creates a workspace with starter files — no billing\". That reduces anxiety.

mike: Love the explicitness. For analytics, tag CTAs: data-cta=\"create_workspace\" and data-cta=\"try_sample_<id>\" so we can A/B later.

tori: Accessibility nit: ensure touch targets remain >=44px after you thin the rail. If you reduce padding, increase hit area via invisible padding.

a11y-bot: Automated compliance note: compact rail with 8px internal padding yields 36px buttons — fails target size. Recommend 12px padding or explicit min-width/height 44px.

carol: I'll update the figma tokens: primary -> solid #0b6eff, label \"Create workspace\"; secondary -> ghost with darker stroke (#155ab8) label \"Try a sample project — 3 min\"; sample cards: show label on mobile for first two; aria-labels added; banner set aria-hidden on first visit; add live region for sample starts; ensure 44px touch targets.

mike: Also consider reducing modal friction when starting sample: skip optional steps with \"advanced settings\" collapsible. Keep primary path 1-2 clicks.

ravi: UX tiny: add a quick inline progress indicator on the CTA after click: \"Creating workspace...\" so user knows something happened. Announce it to SRs via role=status.

tori: All set from me pending changes. I'll spot-check contrast and keyboard order once the PR is up.

carol: Thanks all — I'll push an updated prototype and open a PR with a checklist. Will ping here with the PR link. 

mike: Thanks! :thumbsup:

carol: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/abcd1234 — includes aria-labels, stroke change, and live region. Please review when you have a sec. (closing the thread after reviews)
